server.name: OHLCX
server.description: OHLCX MCP server: trading platform tools for strategies, backtests, signals, trades, workspaces, watchlists, screeners, accounts and orders (read-only), support tickets, markets, sectors, news, conditions, knowledge base, and user management.
server.instructions: OHLCX is a trading platform: strategies, backtests, signals, trades, workspaces, accounts, and market data. Tools expose the user's strategies (settings, schedule, statistics, performance), saved backtests, signals, trades, Workspaces, watchlists, accounts with their balances, profit and loss, cash transfers and broker orders (read-only), support tickets, markets, tickers and their price bars, screeners, sectors, news, conditions, and the knowledge base. No tool places, changes or cancels a broker order directly; a strategy that is switched on with orders on does. Confirm with the user before switching a strategy or its orders on, changing its settings, or deleting anything. Choosing a strategy's order routing accounts (set-strategy-accounts) decides which brokerage accounts receive its orders and never switches orders on: confirm it with the user too. Read the ohlcx://strategy-settings resource before creating a strategy or changing its settings. Prompts provide user context, product terminology (TSP, OCO, TRIM, order types), and support content from the knowledge base. When the user is authenticated, prefer using tools to fetch fresh data before answering.

prompts.name: user-info
prompts.description: Current user summary (authenticated MCP session only)

resources.name: strategy-settings
resources.description: Every strategy setting by section, with its allowed values

tools.name: ping
tools.notes: Health check; no args.

tools.name: run-support-agent
tools.notes: Laravel AI support agent, run as a guest; it only reads (knowledge base tools and the ohlcx.com page reader); triggers LLM.

tools.name: run-trading-agent
tools.notes: Laravel AI trading assistant with the signed-in user's own tools; not read-only (can change the user's settings and preferences; for an admin, a user's credits and billing package); authenticated MCP only; triggers LLM.

tools.name: get-user
tools.notes: Current user; admins may pass user_id for another user.

tools.name: list-users
tools.notes: Search, pagination. Bounds: `per_page` 1-100 (default 20), `page`; `meta` with `has_more`.

tools.name: set-user-admin
tools.notes: Set/clear is_admin.

tools.name: update-user
tools.notes: Update name, email, is_admin, email_verified.

tools.name: add-user
tools.notes: Create user.

tools.name: delete-user
tools.notes: Delete by ID; cannot delete self.

tools.name: search-knowledge-base
tools.notes: Filter by area, q; uses DB. Available to all. Bounds: `limit` 1-200 (default 50), `offset`; `more`, `next_offset`.

tools.name: get-knowledge-base-article
tools.notes: Article by slug; uses DB. Available to all.

tools.name: create-knowledge-base-article
tools.notes: Create KB article.

tools.name: update-knowledge-base-article
tools.notes: Update KB article by id.

tools.name: delete-knowledge-base-article
tools.notes: Delete KB article by id.

tools.name: list-accounts
tools.notes: User's brokerage accounts: id, masked number, type, balances; never the broker's key or a full number. Bounds: the API lists at most 100; `limit` 1-100.

tools.name: list-strategy-accounts
tools.notes: Linked accounts as strategies can route orders to them: id, masked label, routable or the reason not. Pro only. Read-only.

tools.name: set-strategy-accounts
tools.notes: Choose which linked accounts receive a strategy's orders (selected ids, or all). Pro only. Decides where orders go: confirm first.

tools.name: get-account-balance
tools.notes: Daily balance history of one account: its id, masked number and history; never the broker's key. Bounds: the API keeps the 360 most recent rows; `limit` 1-360.

tools.name: get-account-growth
tools.notes: Account growth by account_id (the id list-accounts gives, as a number or digits); never the broker's key or a full number. Bounds: answers {account_id, account, growth}; the API reads the 120 most recent rows; `limit` 1-120.

tools.name: get-account-pnl
tools.notes: Account PnL by account_id (the id list-accounts gives, as a number or digits); never the broker's key or a full number. Bounds: answers {account_id, account, pnl}; the API reads the 120 most recent rows; `limit` 1-120.

tools.name: get-accounts-balances
tools.notes: Daily balance history of every linked account, one entry per account with its id and masked number; optional days (default 30). Bounds: `days` 1-365 (default 30), `limit` 1-200 (default 50), `offset`; `more`, `next_offset`.

tools.name: get-account-pnl-history
tools.notes: Realized P&L over time for an account (account_id: the id list-accounts gives); optional period or from/to. No broker key; the account number is a masked label. Bounds: `limit` 1-1000 (default 366); `more`.

tools.name: get-account-pnl-symbols
tools.notes: Realized P&L by symbol for an account (account_id: the id list-accounts gives); optional period or from/to, symbol, underlying. No broker key; the account number is a masked label. Bounds: `symbols` largest move first, `limit` 1-200 (default 50), `offset`, `more`, `next_offset`; `round_trips` most recent first, `round_trips_limit` 1-200 (default 50), `more_round_trips`.

tools.name: list-account-cash-transfers
tools.notes: Deposits and withdrawals of an account (account_id: the id list-accounts gives); optional period or from/to, direction, q, page, per_page. No broker key; the account number is a masked label. Bounds: `page`, `per_page` 1-50 (default 25); `meta` with `has_more`.

tools.name: list-orders
tools.notes: Broker orders between two dates; optional account_id (the id list-accounts gives), status, max_results; account numbers are masked labels. Read-only. Bounds: `max_results` 1-500 (default 100); no pages, narrow the dates.

tools.name: get-order
tools.notes: One broker order by account_id (the id list-accounts gives) and order_id; the account number in it is a masked label. Read-only.

tools.name: list-activities
tools.notes: User's Activities Feed; no broker key, account numbers as masked labels. Bounds: `page`, `per_page` 1-50 (default 30); `meta` with `has_more`.

tools.name: log-activity
tools.notes: Log activity.

tools.name: delete-activity
tools.notes: Delete activity by id.

tools.name: get-analysis
tools.notes: User's AI analysis data. Bounds: `page`, `per_page` 1-50 (default 10); `meta` with `has_more`.

tools.name: get-ai-usage
tools.notes: The user's AI usage by agent and source; optional range or from/to.

tools.name: list-strategies
tools.notes: User's strategies; optional page and per_page ask for the paged list. Bounds: the first 50 without arguments; `page` 1-100000, `per_page` 1-50 for the paged list; `meta`: current_page, last_page, per_page, total, has_more.

tools.name: get-strategy
tools.notes: Strategy by id; its routing block as the routing tools give it (ids, masked labels, plain-words reasons). Bounds: its conditions, flags, signals and trades come at most 100 each (the API's bound).

tools.name: create-strategy
tools.notes: Create strategy.

tools.name: update-strategy
tools.notes: Update strategy by id. Refused while deployed: retain-strategy first.

tools.name: delete-strategy
tools.notes: Delete strategy by id. Refused while deployed: retain-strategy first.

tools.name: search-strategies
tools.notes: Search strategies by symbol. Bounds: `page`, `offset`; `meta` with `has_more`, `next_offset`.

tools.name: get-strategy-activities
tools.notes: Strategy activities by strategy_id. Bounds: the API gives the latest 10; `limit` 1-10.

tools.name: get-strategy-conditions
tools.notes: Strategy conditions by strategy_id. Bounds: `page`, `offset`; `meta` with `has_more`, `next_offset`.

tools.name: deploy-strategy
tools.notes: Deploy strategy.

tools.name: retain-strategy
tools.notes: Retain a strategy (take it out of evaluation); stop true also switches orders, trades and signals off (owner only).

tools.name: duplicate-strategy
tools.notes: Duplicate strategy.

tools.name: clear-strategy-conditions-readings
tools.notes: Clear condition readings for strategy. Refused while deployed: retain-strategy first.

tools.name: get-strategy-statistics
tools.notes: One strategy's statistics; optional period, status, direction.

tools.name: get-strategies-statistics
tools.notes: Statistics across all the user's strategies; optional period, status, direction.

tools.name: get-strategy-performance
tools.notes: One strategy's performance; optional period, status, direction. Bounds: one row per day of the period, at most a year.

tools.name: get-strategies-performance
tools.notes: Performance across all the user's strategies; optional period, status, direction. Bounds: one row per day of the period, at most a year.

tools.name: get-strategy-timeline
tools.notes: Get a strategy's activity timeline: what it did, day by day, over the last days. Bounds: the most recent whole days that fit one answer (about three); `days` 1-365 (default 3), `logged_only` for more days; `returned`, `more`.

tools.name: list-strategy-signals
tools.notes: List the signals a strategy has raised, 100 per page. Bounds: `page`, `offset`; `meta` with `has_more`, `next_offset`.

tools.name: list-strategy-trades
tools.notes: List the trades a strategy has taken, 100 per page. Bounds: `page`, `offset`; `meta` with `has_more`, `next_offset`.

tools.name: get-strategy-flags
tools.notes: List the flags a strategy's conditions have raised, 100 per page. Bounds: `page`, `offset`; `meta` with `has_more`, `next_offset`.

tools.name: set-strategy-status
tools.notes: Switch a strategy on or off (owner only). On is refused while deployed (retain-strategy first); off always works.

tools.name: set-strategy-flag
tools.notes: signals, trades or orders (or their notifications): on, off, toggle (owner only). On and toggle are refused while deployed (retain-strategy first); off always works.

tools.name: set-strategy-schedule
tools.notes: Set the days and hours a strategy is allowed to run. Times are New York time. Refused while deployed: retain-strategy first.

tools.name: update-strategy-settings
tools.notes: One validated section at a time; see the ohlcx://strategy-settings resource (owner only). Refused while deployed: retain-strategy first.

tools.name: clear-strategy-data
tools.notes: Delete a strategy's signals, trades or flags (owner only). Clearing flags is refused while deployed, and signals while deployed, real and with orders on (retain-strategy first); trades never.

tools.name: list-signals
tools.notes: User's signals. Bounds: `page`, `offset`; `meta` with `has_more`, `next_offset`.

tools.name: list-backtests
tools.notes: Saved runs, newest first; optional strategy_id, page. Bounds: `page`, `offset`; `meta` with `has_more`, `next_offset`.

tools.name: get-backtest
tools.notes: One saved run; trades, equity and strategy_snapshot only when named in include. Bounds: the parts named in `include` lose rows when the answer is over 256 KB (`truncated`, `more`); the whole run is in the app.

tools.name: rename-backtest
tools.notes: Rename a saved backtest run.

tools.name: delete-backtest
tools.notes: Delete a saved backtest run. This cannot be undone.

tools.name: run-backtest
tools.notes: Server-side run; listed only when server backtests are switched on.

tools.name: run-backtest-sweep
tools.notes: Server-side sweep over one or two settings; listed only when server backtests are switched on.

tools.name: list-backtest-jobs
tools.notes: Server-side jobs with status and progress; listed only when server backtests are switched on. Bounds: `page`, `offset`; `meta` with `has_more`, `next_offset`.

tools.name: get-backtest-job
tools.notes: Poll a server-side job; listed only when server backtests are switched on.

tools.name: cancel-backtest-job
tools.notes: Cancel a waiting or running job; listed only when server backtests are switched on.

tools.name: list-trades
tools.notes: Strategy trades; optional symbol, period, status, direction, page. Bounds: `page`, `offset`; `meta` with `has_more`, `next_offset`.

tools.name: get-trade
tools.notes: Get one strategy trade by ID.

tools.name: delete-trade
tools.notes: Delete a trade record; does not touch the broker.

tools.name: get-signal
tools.notes: Get one signal by ID, with its strategy and trades.

tools.name: delete-signal
tools.notes: Delete a signal. This cannot be undone. Refused only while its strategy is deployed, real and has orders on (retain-strategy first).

tools.name: set-signal-action
tools.notes: like, unlike, ignore, unignore, watch or unwatch a signal.

tools.name: get-signal-actions
tools.notes: Get how the authenticated user has marked a signal: liked, ignored, watched.

tools.name: get-workspaces
tools.notes: The user's Workspaces document and its revision.

tools.name: save-workspaces
tools.notes: Replace the Workspaces document against a revision; a stale revision returns the current state.

tools.name: list-watchlists
tools.notes: The user's watchlists, the built-in ones, and the hidden built-ins. Bounds: `limit` 1-200 (default 50), `offset`; `more`, `next_offset`.

tools.name: create-watchlist
tools.notes: Create an empty watchlist for the authenticated user. Add symbols with add-watchlist-symbols.

tools.name: rename-watchlist
tools.notes: Rename one of the authenticated user's watchlists.

tools.name: delete-watchlist
tools.notes: Delete one of the authenticated user's watchlists and the symbols in it. This cannot be undone.

tools.name: add-watchlist-symbols
tools.notes: Add one or more symbols to one of the authenticated user's watchlists. Symbols already in it are kept once.

tools.name: remove-watchlist-symbol
tools.notes: Remove one symbol from one of the authenticated user's watchlists.

tools.name: list-markets
tools.notes: Markets; optional market_id. Bounds: `page`, `offset`; `meta` with `has_more`, `next_offset`.

tools.name: list-sectors
tools.notes: Sectors from proxied API; optional per_page. Bounds: `page`, `per_page` 1-100 (default 10); `meta` with `has_more`.

tools.name: get-sector
tools.notes: Sector by sector_id (digits only).

tools.name: get-ticker
tools.notes: Ticker by symbol or market_id. Bounds: `page`, `offset`; `meta` with `has_more`, `next_offset`.

tools.name: get-market-calendar
tools.notes: Market calendar.

tools.name: get-market-balance
tools.notes: Market balance; optional filters.

tools.name: get-sector-balance
tools.notes: Sector balance; optional filters.

tools.name: screen-market-gaps
tools.notes: Gap screen of a market; optional market_id, gap_min_percent, direction. Bounds: `limit` 1-200 (default 50), `offset`; `more`, `next_offset`.

tools.name: screen-asset-gaps
tools.notes: Gap screen of one symbol; optional timeframe, gap_min_percent, direction. Bounds: `limit` 1-200 (default 50), `offset`; `more`, `next_offset`.

tools.name: screen-technicals
tools.notes: Technical readings per symbol for a market; optional market_id, timeframe, search, page, per_page. Bounds: `page`, `per_page` 1-50 (default 20); `meta` with `has_more`.

tools.name: get-ticker-bars
tools.notes: Price bars for a symbol; newest 200 by default, cursor paginated. Bounds: `limit` 1-1000 (default 200), `cursor` to continue.

tools.name: get-ticker-analysis
tools.notes: Published analysis for one symbol; optional page. Bounds: `page`, `offset`; `meta` with `has_more`, `next_offset`.

tools.name: list-news
tools.notes: Paginated news. Bounds: `page`, `per_page` 1-50 (default 10); `meta` with `has_more`.

tools.name: get-news
tools.notes: News item by id.

tools.name: list-crypto-news
tools.notes: Paginated crypto news. Bounds: `page`, `per_page` 1-50 (default 10); `meta` with `has_more`.

tools.name: list-popular-news
tools.notes: Paginated popular news. Bounds: `page`, `per_page` 1-50 (default 10); `meta` with `has_more`.

tools.name: list-conditions
tools.notes: All conditions. Bounds: `page`, `offset`; `meta` with `has_more`, `next_offset`.

tools.name: get-condition
tools.notes: Condition by id.

tools.name: create-condition
tools.notes: Create condition. Refused while the strategy is deployed: retain-strategy first.

tools.name: update-condition
tools.notes: Update condition by id. Refused while the strategy is deployed: retain-strategy first.

tools.name: delete-condition
tools.notes: Delete condition by id. Refused while the strategy is deployed: retain-strategy first.

tools.name: submit-contact-form
tools.notes: Submit contact form.

tools.name: report-issue
tools.notes: Report issue.

tools.name: submit-support-request
tools.notes: Submit support request.

tools.name: list-support-tickets
tools.notes: The user's support tickets; optional status. Bounds: `page`, `offset`; `meta` with `has_more`, `next_offset`.

tools.name: get-support-ticket
tools.notes: Get one of the authenticated user's support tickets with its messages. Bounds: a conversation over 256 KB keeps its newest messages (`truncated`, `more`).

tools.name: create-support-ticket
tools.notes: Open a support ticket: subject, body, optional category and priority.

tools.name: reply-support-ticket
tools.notes: Add a message from the authenticated user to one of their support tickets. The support team is notified. Confirm the wording with the user first.

tools.name: get-credits
tools.notes: User's credit balance.

tools.name: get-transaction-history
tools.notes: User's billing history. Bounds: the latest 100 of each list is all the reader gives; `limit` 1-100.

tools.name: list-credit-holds
tools.notes: Credit holds and their status, without the broker's key for an account; optional page, per_page. Read-only. Bounds: `page`, `per_page` 1-50 (default 25); `meta` with `has_more`.

tools.name: get-sessions
tools.notes: User's sessions. Bounds: `limit` 1-200 (default 50), `offset`; `more`, `next_offset`.

tools.name: update-profile
tools.notes: Update profile.

tools.name: update-password
tools.notes: Update password.

tools.name: delete-profile-photo
tools.notes: Delete profile photo.

tools.name: get-onboarding
tools.notes: User onboarding state.

tools.name: complete-onboarding
tools.notes: Submit onboarding.

tools.name: get-preferences
tools.notes: User preferences.

tools.name: update-preferences
tools.notes: Update preferences.

tools.name: get-settings
tools.notes: User settings.

tools.name: save-settings
tools.notes: Save settings.

tools.name: get-group
tools.notes: Trading room group by id.

tools.name: create-group
tools.notes: Create group.

tools.name: update-group
tools.notes: Update group.

tools.name: delete-group
tools.notes: Delete group.

tools.name: invite-to-group
tools.notes: Invite to group.

tools.name: join-group
tools.notes: Join group.

tools.name: leave-group
tools.notes: Leave group.

tools.name: get-group-status
tools.notes: Group status.

tools.name: discover-groups
tools.notes: Trading rooms open to join; optional search. Bounds: `page`, `offset`; `meta` with `has_more`, `next_offset`.

tools.name: browse-users
tools.notes: Other users to message or invite; optional search. Bounds: `page`, `offset`; `meta` with `has_more`, `next_offset`.

tools.name: list-invites
tools.notes: User's invites. Bounds: `page`, `per_page` 1-50 (default 10); `meta` with `has_more`.

tools.name: send-invite
tools.notes: Send invite.

tools.name: accept-invite
tools.notes: Accept invite.

tools.name: respond-join-request
tools.notes: Respond to join request.

tools.name: list-pending-join-requests
tools.notes: Join requests waiting on rooms the user owns. Bounds: `limit` 1-200 (default 50), `offset`; `more`, `next_offset`.

tools.name: send-message
tools.notes: Send message in room.

tools.name: get-older-messages
tools.notes: Older messages before message_id. Bounds: 10 at a time; `meta.has_more`.

tools.name: delete-message
tools.notes: Delete message.

tools.name: get-sidebar-conversations
tools.notes: Sidebar conversation list. Bounds: `limit` 1-200 (default 50), `offset`; `more`, `next_offset`.

tools.name: get-unread-messages
tools.notes: Unread messages by conversation. Bounds: the API gives the latest 50; `limit` 1-50.

tools.name: get-user-billing
tools.notes: User billing (admin); no broker key, account numbers as masked labels. Bounds: held to the 256 KB budget.

tools.name: adjust-user-billing
tools.notes: Adjust user billing (admin).

tools.name: set-user-billing-package
tools.notes: Set user billing package (admin).

tools.name: block-unblock-user
tools.notes: Block/unblock user (admin).

tools.name: change-user-role
tools.notes: Change user role (admin).
